Coverage_Description: 90-day relocation protection covering overseas medical (hospitalisation/surgery/outpatient), personal accident (death/disability), mental care after covered traumatic events, famil
pricing: HK$1,300 (Basic, applicant only); HK$2,300 (Premier, applicant only); HK$3,600 (Basic, applicant & family); HK$6,300 (Premier, applicant & family).
customer requirement: Applicant must be an insured person; application signer age 18+
price structure: Single premium for a 90-day policy; tiered by plan level (Basic/Premier) and insured group (individual/family)
additional informations: Excess-free policy; free 90-day departure extension if original departure is delayed; COVID-19 medical expenses covered under policy terms (including vaccination requirement)
